This script defines the helper functions used across the analysis: harmonizing the liver and kidney copies of a variable, recoding SRTR codes into labels, and turning Cox models into tables of hazard ratios.

::: Rcode
### Source code

The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/functions/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/blob/master/R/functions/functions.R)

It is sourced by [`R/main.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/blob/master/R/main.R) after:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/blob/master/R/setup.R)
:::
